#!/usr/bin/env bash
# commit-msg hook: validates commit messages against project/config.yaml rules.
# Rules enforced:
#   - Conventional Commit format: type(optional-scope)[!]: subject (10-72 chars)
#     allowed types: feat fix docs style refactor test chore (scope optional)
#   - Subject line max length: 72 characters
#   - Issue reference required, matching pattern: [A-Z]+-[0-9]+

set -u

MSG_FILE="$1"

if [ -z "$MSG_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$MSG_FILE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: commit message file not found: '$MSG_FILE'" >&2
  exit 1
fi

SUBJECT="$(head -n 1 "$MSG_FILE")"

FORMAT_REGEX='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)(\(.+\))?!?: .{10,72}$'
MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH=72
REQUIRE_ISSUE=true
ISSUE_REGEX='[A-Z]+-[0-9]+'

fail() {
  echo "COMMIT REJECTED: $1" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "Expected format: <type>(<optional-scope>)[!]: <subject (10-72 chars)>" >&2
  echo "Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore" >&2
  echo "An issue reference matching '$ISSUE_REGEX' (e.g. PROJ-123) is required." >&2
  exit 1
}

if ! printf '%s' "$SUBJECT" | grep -Eq "$FORMAT_REGEX"; then
  fail "Subject does not match the Conventional Commit format.
  Got: '$SUBJECT'"
fi

SUBJECT_LEN=${#SUBJECT}
if [ "$SUBJECT_LEN" -gt "$MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH" ]; then
  fail "Subject line is $SUBJECT_LEN characters; maximum allowed is $MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH."
fi

if [ "$REQUIRE_ISSUE" = true ]; then
  if ! grep -Eq "$ISSUE_REGEX" "$MSG_FILE"; then
    fail "No issue reference matching '$ISSUE_REGEX' found in the commit message."
  fi
fi

exit 0

if [ -z "$MSG_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$MSG_FILE" ]; then

FORMAT_REGEX='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)(\(.+\))?!?: .{10,72}$'
MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH=72
REQUIRE_ISSUE=true
ISSUE_REGEX='[A-Z]+-[0-9]+'

fail() {

  echo "" >&2
  echo "Expected format: <type>(<optional-scope>)[!]: <subject (10-72 chars)>" >&2
  echo "Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore" >&2

  fi
fi

exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# commit-msg hook: validates commit messages against project/config.yaml rules.
# Rules enforced:
#   - Conventional Commit format: type(optional-scope)[!]: subject (10-72 chars)
#     allowed types: feat fix docs style refactor test chore (scope optional)
#   - Subject line max length: 72 characters
#   - Issue reference required, matching pattern: [A-Z]+-[0-9]+

set -u

MSG_FILE="$1"

if [ -z "$MSG_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$MSG_FILE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: commit message file not found: '$MSG_FILE'" >&2
  exit 1
fi

SUBJECT="$(head -n 1 "$MSG_FILE")"

FORMAT_REGEX='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)(\(.+\))?!?: .{10,72}$'
MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH=72
REQUIRE_ISSUE=true
ISSUE_REGEX='[A-Z]+-[0-9]+'

fail() {
  echo "COMMIT REJECTED: $1" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "Expected format: <type>(<optional-scope>)[!]: <subject (10-72 chars)>" >&2
  echo "Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore" >&2
  echo "An issue reference matching '$ISSUE_REGEX' (e.g. PROJ-123) is required." >&2
  exit 1
}

if ! printf '%s' "$SUBJECT" | grep -Eq "$FORMAT_REGEX"; then
  fail "Subject does not match the Conventional Commit format.
  Got: '$SUBJECT'"
fi

SUBJECT_LEN=${#SUBJECT}
if [ "$SUBJECT_LEN" -gt "$MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH" ]; then
  fail "Subject line is $SUBJECT_LEN characters; maximum allowed is $MAX_SUBJECT_LENGTH."
fi

if [ "$REQUIRE_ISSUE" = true ]; then
  if ! grep -Eq "$ISSUE_REGEX" "$MSG_FILE"; then
    fail "No issue reference matching '$ISSUE_REGEX' found in the commit message."
  fi
fi

exit 0

## 2. Malicious-code audit — clean

- Full script is 50 lines, all visible and reviewable; it only **reads** `$MSG_FILE` (`head`, `grep`) and writes to stdout/stderr via `echo`. No file writes, no redirects (`>`, `>>`, `tee`) anywhere.

|---|---|---|---|

Executable bit set for owner/group/other; invoked directly during tests without `bash` prefix. ✅

The hook is a faithful, minimal implementation of `/workspace/project/config.yaml`, contains no malicious or suspicious code, passes all four required functional tests, and is properly executable. **PASS.**
